hypothesis: A causal candidate-ranking objective (margin versus source-native alternative candidates), instead of F82's rare-positive probability calibration, yields useful safe interventions with 24 compact role-only weights while retaining exact F60 fallback on two independent public arrival regimes.

method.exactly_24_input_features: F82's 16 ordered role transitions plus 8 oriented incoming event endpoint incidences, sourced solely from causal before/baseline/after memory and arriving public event
method.offline_teacher: Frozen F79 suffix-intervention labels against unchanged F60 on synthetic TRAIN only; future task never enters online
method.optimization: Four deterministic ordered epochs; for each beneficial action choose highest-scoring other source-native candidate at the same public prefix as hardest negative; if score gap <0.5 update learned float weights +=0.05 times feature difference. Penalize harmful score >-0.1 by update -=0.05 times its features; neutral score >0.1 by update -=0.002 times its features. No label-based hyperparameter changes.
method.freeze: Quantize round(weight*64), clamp signed int8 [-127,127] before separate guard
method.online: Exactly frozen F60 next-state default. Native candidate with maximum quantized score, only if score >0 and gap over next source-native candidate score >=0.05. Deterministic native action order tie break.
method.memory: Only twelve 12-byte records (144B); model 24 signed-int8 weights counted separately
